text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text:
The duel between Nea and Kariza unfolded
before {0}'s eyes. The outcome
was...
text_block_list.orig_text:
{0}の目の前で、
繰り広げられたネアとカリザの決闘。
その行く末は──

text_block_list.name: Kariza
text_block_list.text:
DAMMIT! I can't move because of the slime...!
And don't get it inside my clothes...! That's
unfair! Let go of me!!
text_block_list.orig_text:
クソっ！　
スライムのせいで動けねぇ……っ！
てか
服の中に入ってくんじゃねぇっ……！
こんなん卑怯だろ！　
放しやがれ！！

text_block_list.name: Nea
text_block_list.text:
Nfufu... That was like, stupid easy♡ Big Sis
Nea in "anti-shota mode"? Totally
unbeatable~♡
text_block_list.orig_text:
ンフ・
どちゃくそヨユー♡
ショタ特効モードなネアおねーちゃん、
マジ無敵なんで～♡

text_block_list.name: Nea
text_block_list.text:
Guess you can't handle it without your
Princess Form, huh~? Shall we change your
clothes? Kariza-kyun... it's been a while♡
text_block_list.orig_text:
やっぱ
プリンセスフォームじゃねーとムリくね～？
お着替えする～？　
カリザきゅん～　
ヒサビサに♡

text_block_list.name: Kariza
text_block_list.text:
D-Don't be ridiculous...! I'LL KILL YOU RIGHT
NOW!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ふ、
ふざけんなっ……！
今すぐブチ殺してやる！

text_block_list.name: Nea
text_block_list.text:
Kariza-kyun's cute yelping when he's caught
is nice... but it's kinda lacking, y'know~?
text_block_list.orig_text:
捕まりながら
キャンキャンゆってる
カリザきゅんもカワいーけど～
な～んか物足りねーんだよな～？

text_block_list.name: Nea
text_block_list.text:
But, well... Honestly? Maybe this will give
us a clue about that "true power" thing~?
We'll continue tomorrow~ Next time, please
make it even more fun~ Kariza-kyun♡ I'll get
things ready so you can get even more worked
up next time, Kariza-kyun~♡
text_block_list.orig_text:
でもま。
ホンテ？　
のヒントになるかもだし～？　
続きはまた明日～
次はもっと楽しませてね～
カリザきゅん♡
おねえちゃんも
カリザきゅんが
も～
っとアガるように
準備してくっから♡

text_block_list.name: Nea
text_block_list.text: Now, let's go... Knight-kyun.
text_block_list.orig_text:
んじゃ行こー
騎士きゅん～

text_block_list.name: Kariza
text_block_list.text:
Ah... HEY! WAIT! DON'T LEAVE ME HERE LIKE
THIS! AT LEAST GET ME OUT OF THIS THING, YOU
BITCH SLIME WOMAAAAAAAAN!
text_block_list.orig_text:
あっ、
オイ！　
待ちやがれ！
オレをこのままにすんじゃねー！
せめてここから出せ
クソスライム女ーっ！

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text:
The next day, {0} came to check on
Nea before his part-time job.
text_block_list.orig_text:
翌日。
{0}はアルバイトの前に
ネアの様子を見に訪れた。

text_block_list.name: Nea
text_block_list.text:
Hmmmm? Morning, Knight-kyun♡ Worried about
our duel? Don't worry, it fine! Think of it
like a game~
text_block_list.orig_text:
ン、
はよー騎士きゅん♡
決闘の心配してんの～？　
ダイジョーブダイジョーブ、
遊びみたいなモンだってー

text_block_list.name: Nea
text_block_list.text:
Yesterday's duel felt kind of underwhelming,
or rather, boring, right? The-re-fo-re...
I've prepared some toys to play with~♪ Like
body paint and stuff that, like, doubles the
sensation~♡
text_block_list.orig_text:
昨日の決闘、
なんか物足んねーってか
ダルめだったっしょ。
だ・
か・
ら、
遊び道具用意したった～♪
ボディーペイントとかー　
カンド倍増させるクスリとかー♡

text_block_list.name: Nea
text_block_list.text:
Don't worry, I haven't included anything
seriously dangerous♪ I'm going to thoroughly
enjoy my duel with Kariza-kyun♡ So, if
there's anything that catches your eye,
Knight-kyun, feel free to use it too~♡
text_block_list.orig_text:
心配いらねーって、
ガチにやべーのは入れてねーし♪
カリザきゅんとの決闘、
ズブズブに楽しまんと♡
ってワケで
騎士きゅんも気になるのあったら
使っていいかんねー

text_block_list.name: Nea
text_block_list.text:
Well now, that's... a potion made by some
alchemist, I think? I believe she said it
"temporarily turns you into a slime". I
ordered it during a sale but haven't used it
yet. I wonder if this'll be the time?
text_block_list.orig_text:
ソレはねー　
どっかの錬金術師が作ったクスリ～
「一時的にスライム化させる」
とか言ってたかな～
セールんとき注文したけど
使ってなくて。
今回使えっかな？

text_block_list.name: Nea
text_block_list.text: Wait, hm? Didn't you swallow it just now...?
text_block_list.orig_text:
って、
ン？
今飲み込んでなかった……？

text_block_list.name: Nea
text_block_list.text:
Seriously? Knight-kyun... you've turned into
a slime!
text_block_list.orig_text:
マ？
騎士きゅん、
スライムになってんじゃん！？

text_block_list.name: Nea
text_block_list.text:
Oh my~ Rather than a little boy... you're
more like a baby, huh~? Or rather... crap,
you're so cute~! So squishy~!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ありゃま～　
何でも口にしちゃうの
ショタってゆーより、
赤ちゃんっぽ～？
てか──
やべ、
めっちゃカワイ～～！　
ぷにぷにしてんじゃん～

text_block_list.name: Nea
text_block_list.text:
Well, it's fine, y'know. She said the
duration is temporary. Plus, Slime
Knight-kyun is quite fun♪ I'm kinda getting
addicted to poking you like this~♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
ま、
ダイジョーブっしょ。
時間たてば戻るって言ってたし。
それに
スライムの騎士きゅんもおもしれーし♪
ツンツンすんの
癖になるわ～

text_block_list.name: Nea
text_block_list.text:
Ah, but... Knight-kyun. Didn't you say you
had part-time work after this?
text_block_list.orig_text:
あ、
でも騎士きゅん。
この後バイトって言ってたっけ？

text_block_list.name: Nea
text_block_list.text:
You did, right? Guess you're going like that,
huh~? Can't be helped, Big Sis'll give you a
hand♪ See it as thanks for yesterday~
text_block_list.orig_text:
そーだったよねー？　
その姿でも行くつもりか～
しゃーなし、
おねえちゃんが手伝ってやんよ～
昨日のお礼ってことで。

text_block_list.name: Nea
text_block_list.text:
So this is the meeting place... I think I
recall you saying it was a cleaning job. I
wonder if the client has arrived yet?
text_block_list.orig_text:
ここで待ち合わせかー
今日は清掃のバイト
つったっけか。
依頼主は来てんのかなー

text_block_list.text:
Hellooooo! Young lady... are you the one who
applied for today's job? I'm looking forward
to working with you today! Huh? Wait, you...
this isn't the first we meet, is it?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
こんにちは～！
お嬢ちゃんが
アルバイトに応募してくれた子かな～？
今日はよろしくお願いします！　
あれ、
初めて……
じゃないよね、
キミ？

text_block_list.name: Nea
text_block_list.text:
Ah, well... the one who applied is
Knight-kyun right here. I'm more like his
helper... or an attendant, I guess? Wait,
nn...?
text_block_list.orig_text:
あ、
いや
応募したのは
こっちの騎士きゅん。
アタシは付き添いっつーか
手伝いっつーか、
なカンジ？
って、
ン……？

text_block_list.name: Merchant
text_block_list.text:
Oh my? Young lady, are you with this guy?
You're so cute~! Make sure to buy something!
How about a skincare serum that makes your
skin all smooth and glossy?
text_block_list.orig_text:
おや？　
お嬢ちゃん、
この人のツレ？
かわいいね～！
なんか買ってってよ。
肌がつやつやになる美容液なんかどー？

text_block_list.name: Nea
text_block_list.text: Skincare serum, you say? Hmm? Sniff sniff...
text_block_list.orig_text:
これがびよーえきー？
ン～～～？
くんくん……

text_block_list.name: Nea
text_block_list.text:
No, wait... you're joking, aren't you, Pops?
This is slime mucus, isn't it~?
text_block_list.orig_text:
いや、
待ってー
ジョーダンでしょーオッサ～ン？
これ、
スライムのネンエキじゃーん？

text_block_list.name: Merchant
text_block_list.text:
HUH!? H-How did you know that...!? I added a
scent and diluted it so nobody would
notice...!
text_block_list.orig_text:
っ！？　
ど、
どうしてそれを……！？
分からないように匂いもつけて、
薄めたはず……！

text_block_list.name: Nea
text_block_list.text:
...Hey, you. You're that Pops from back then,
aren't you? Trying to scam us? Want me to
shut that mouth of yours again~?
text_block_list.orig_text:
──あんた、
いつかのオッサンじゃん。
また詐欺る気か～？　
もっかいおクチ
ふさいどくー？

text_block_list.name: Former Merchant
text_block_list.text:
N-NO, YOU'RE WRONG! Wait! I've been
reflecting on my actions ever since! Today's
just a simple cleaning job! I'm only working
diligently right now!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ち、
違う！　
待ってくれ！　
あれから反省したんだっ！
今日は
清掃の仕事！　
今は真面目に働いているよ～！

text_block_list.name: Nea
text_block_list.text:
What a stinking liar~ This is some kind of
shady part-time job, isn't it?
text_block_list.orig_text:
ウソくせ～
やべーバイトってオチじゃないよねー？

text_block_list.name: Former Merchant
text_block_list.text:
I-I'M NOT LYING, IT'S THE TRUTH, I SWEAR!
Right now, um... I have a woman I like...
I've cleaned up my act... I want to become
someone worthy of her...
text_block_list.orig_text:
う、
嘘じゃない、
本当だよっ！
今は、
その……
好きな
女性がいて……
悪い商売からは足を洗ったんだ。
その人に見合う人間になりたくて……

text_block_list.name: Former Merchant
text_block_list.text:
I know perfectly well that it's
understandable that you'd be suspicious. But
still, I really want to start over... I'm so
sorry about what happened back then...
text_block_list.orig_text:
疑
われても仕方ないのは、
よくわかっているさ。
それでも、
ちゃんとやり直したくて……
あの時は、
申し訳なかったよ……

text_block_list.name: Nea
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, so you're serious about rehabilitation~?
Sounds fishy to me... Hmm...
text_block_list.orig_text:
ふーん、
マジメに更生チューってか～？
うさんくさ～……
ンー……

text_block_list.name: Nea
text_block_list.text:
Mmm... For now, guess I'll believe you.
Knight-kyun, you agree seeing how you're
wiggling with that soft body~?
text_block_list.orig_text:
ン・
とりま信じるわー
騎士きゅんも許してそーなぷるぷるしてっし？

text_block_list.name: Former Merchant
text_block_list.text:
THANK YOUUUU! I knew you'd understand me,
young girl! You've had that ability to
discern truth from falsehood even back then!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ありがとう～！
お嬢ちゃんなら、
わかってくれると思ったよ～！
嘘か本当かを見抜く力は、
あの時からあったもんね～！

text_block_list.name: Nea
text_block_list.text:
Uwaah... still sounding a bit slimy, aren't
we? Well, whatever... but if you betray my
pure and innocent Knight-kyun, I'll NEVER
forgive you.
text_block_list.orig_text:
うーわ
なんかチョーシのってね？　
ま、
イイけどー
でも、
ピュアピュアな騎士きゅん裏切ったら
マジゆるさんしー

text_block_list.name: Former Merchant
text_block_list.text:
S-Sure. It's a bad habit of mine to talk like
this. I don't mean anything bad by it. ...By
the way, umm... That slime with you is...?
text_block_list.orig_text:
あ、
ああ。
このしゃべり方は癖なんだ。
悪気はないよ。
……ところで、
その……
一緒にいる、
そのスライムは……？

text_block_list.name: Nea
text_block_list.text: Hmmm? This is Knight-kyun, obviously.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ン？
騎士きゅんに決まってんじゃん。

text_block_list.name: Former Merchant
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, here you go joking again! ...Eh, is
that true?
text_block_list.orig_text:
あはは、
またまたご冗談を～！
……
え、
本当なのかい？

text_block_list.name: Former Merchant
text_block_list.text:
It's just like I explained. I'll start over
there, so you two can get started around
here~
text_block_list.orig_text:
清掃の手順は説明した通りだよ。
オレは
あっちから始めるから、
お嬢ちゃんたちは、
この辺りから頼むよ～

text_block_list.name: Nea
text_block_list.text:
Ugh, what a pain~ This place is so huge...
Well, guess we better get started... Huh?
Where's Knight-kyun?
text_block_list.orig_text:
だり～
めちゃ広いじゃん。
んじゃ、
アタシらもやるかー……
って、
あれ？　
騎士きゅんは？

text_block_list.name: Nea
text_block_list.text:
Whoa... you fell into the drain!? Here... are
you okay?
text_block_list.orig_text:
げ、
排水溝に落ちてんじゃん。
よ
っと、
ダイジョーブだった？

text_block_list.name: Nea
text_block_list.text:
Slimes are like slippery water, so if you
aren't careful, you'll pass through holes and
stuff~
text_block_list.orig_text:
スライムって、
ぬるっとした水みたいなもんだからさ～
気～付けんと、
穴とか通り抜けちゃうんだよね～

text_block_list.name: Nea
text_block_list.text:
But, well... once you get used to it, it's
super handy♡ You can clean stuff like
Kariza-kyun's body... and if you really go
for it, you can clean a whole big room in one
go... like a place this big, for example~
text_block_list.orig_text:
までも、
慣れたら便利だぜ♡　
カリザきゅんの身体をお掃除したりー
やろーと思えば、
広い部屋も
イッキに掃除できるしー
例えばこういうデカい通りとかも……

text_block_list.name: Nea
text_block_list.text:
This is a pain, so why don't we just do that?
I'll use my slime and finish it all at once~♡
text_block_list.orig_text:
つかめんどいし、
そーしよっか？
アタシのスライムで、
イッキに終わらせよ？

text_block_list.name: Nea
text_block_list.text:
Hmmm... I wonder what you're trying to
say...? "I agree"? ...No, doesn't look like
it. Hard to tell with all that wobbling~
text_block_list.orig_text:
ン・
どっちだろ……？　
サンセー？　
……じゃ
なさそうだな。
ぷるぷるわかりにくいんよな～

text_block_list.name: Nea
text_block_list.text:
It's fine that you want to work hard,
Knight-kyun... but is that Pops doing the
same? Let's see...
text_block_list.orig_text:
騎士きゅんがまじめに頑張るのはイイとして、
オッサンもマジメにやってんのか～？
どれどれ……

text_block_list.name: Former Merchant
text_block_list.text:
Aaaall right! Everything's clean now! It
looks so shiny!
text_block_list.orig_text:
よ～し！　
きれいになったぞ！
ピカピカじゃないか～！

text_block_list.name: Grandma
text_block_list.text:
Hello. Thank you for always keeping it so
clean.
text_block_list.orig_text:
こんにちは。
いつもきれいにしてくれて、
ありがとうね。

text_block_list.name: Former Merchant
text_block_list.text:
Th-Thank you very much, Madam! Your words
motivate me to do my very best!
text_block_list.orig_text:
あ、
ありがとうございますマダム～！
そう言っていただけると、
頑張れますよ～！

text_block_list.name: Nea
text_block_list.text:
That Pops' actually working hard. Didn't
expect that, he's doing great.
text_block_list.orig_text:
オッサンも意外と頑張ってんなー
ちゃんとやってんじゃん。

text_block_list.name: Nea
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... Then. I guess I shouldn't be using my
slime.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ンー……
じゃ、
アタシがスライム使うのはちげーか。

text_block_list.name: Nea
text_block_list.text:
Anyway, I'm here to support Knight-kyun,
right? Kinda feels off if I hog the
spotlight~ Guess I'll just do it the slow and
steady way...
text_block_list.orig_text:
とりま今日は
騎士きゅんのサポートだし？
あんまでしゃばんのもビミョーだよねー
じゃ、
地道にいくしかねーか……

text_block_list.name: Nea
text_block_list.text:
Wait... Huh? Knight-kyun, where'd you go?
Heeeeey!
text_block_list.orig_text:
って
あれ？
騎士きゅんどこ行ったー？　
おーい！

text_block_list.name: Adventurer 1
text_block_list.text:
Hey, look. A "Gelatin" got inside the town
just like that...!
text_block_list.orig_text:
おい、
見ろ。
こんな街中に、
ゼラチナがいるぞ……！

text_block_list.name: Adventurer 2
text_block_list.text:
Oh my...! You're right. It's a dangerous
creature, we should defeat it at once!
text_block_list.orig_text:
あら……！　
ほんとね。
危険だわ、
倒していきましょう！

text_block_list.name: Nea
text_block_list.text:
Ahhhh, time out, time out! That's not a
Gelatin. No, no, don't just attack him so
carelessly.
text_block_list.orig_text:
あー、
タンマタンマ。
ゼラチナじゃねーから。
ダメダメ～　
気軽に倒すのやめといて。

text_block_list.name: Nea
text_block_list.text:
That was close. Or rather... I got attacked
by adventurers like that once too~
text_block_list.orig_text:
危なかったねー
つか、
アタシもあの冒険者に襲われたことあったわー

text_block_list.name: Nea
text_block_list.text:
If I remember correctly... right after that,
I met you, Knight-kyun... and then, you saved
me, a slime, from some monsters~
text_block_list.orig_text:
たしか、
そのすぐ後に、
騎士きゅんと出会って～
んで、
スライムのアタシを
魔物から助けてくれたんだよね～

text_block_list.name: Nea
text_block_list.text:
Maaaan, that takes me back~♪ Are doing the
opposite version today?
text_block_list.orig_text:
う～わ
なっつ～♪
今日は、
その逆バージョンってカンジかー？

text_block_list.name: Nea
text_block_list.text:
Well, what I'm saying is... back then, you
were the one who helped me, right? So today,
it's my turn to help you out a bunch~ And not
just today, either~♡
text_block_list.orig_text:
ま、
何が言いてーかってゆーと、
あん時は、
騎士きゅんが助けてくれたんだし？
今日はアタシがイッパイ助けなきゃ～
ってコト。
もち
今日以外でも♡

text_block_list.name: Nea
text_block_list.text:
Besides, you know, Knight-kyun... didn't you
tell me before that you couldn't leave
someone in trouble alone?
text_block_list.orig_text:
それにさー　
騎士きゅん、
前に言ってくれたじゃん？
「困っているところを放っておけなかった」
って。

text_block_list.name: Nea
text_block_list.text:
I feel the same way. So don't hold back,
okay~
text_block_list.orig_text:
アタシもそんなカンジだから。
エンリョはナシでおっけー

text_block_list.name: Nea
text_block_list.text: Ehe♪ Then, let's do our best together♡
text_block_list.orig_text:
ンフ♪
んじゃ、
一緒にがんばろっか♡

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to Nea's support, {0} worked
hard at his part-time cleaning job. Just
before the end of the shift, he was finally
able to return to his human form.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ネアの支えもあり、
清掃バイトに勤しんだ{0}。
業務終了間際に、
やっとスライムから人の姿に戻れたのであった。

text_block_list.name: Nea
text_block_list.text: We did it♪ It's finally over~
text_block_list.orig_text:
やり～♪
終わったった～

text_block_list.name: Former Merchant
text_block_list.text:
Thank you! You really saved me! I'm also glad
you returned human from your slime form, too!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ありがとう、
すごく助かったよ～！
君も
スライムから元に戻れてよかったね～

text_block_list.name: Nea
text_block_list.text:
Didn't expect much, but you actually took it
seriously, Pops~ Gotta say, I'm impressed~
text_block_list.orig_text:
だね～
オッサンもガチってて見直したわ～

text_block_list.name: Former Merchant
text_block_list.text:
Hahaha, I'm glad to hear you say that~
There's people all around greeting me and
cheering me on... that's what gives me the
energy to persevere~
text_block_list.orig_text:
ははは、
そう言ってもらえてうれしいよ～
こんなオレに挨拶をしてくれたり、
感謝してくれる人もいてさ。
実は、
それが励みになってるんだ～

text_block_list.name: Nea
text_block_list.text: Eeeh... Not bad, coming from you, Pops~
text_block_list.orig_text:
へ～
オッサンにしては、
イイコト言うじゃん。

text_block_list.name: Former Merchant
text_block_list.text:
I know, right~? When that happens, it really
makes me want to give it my all, you know?
Never felt that way back when I was a shady
merchant~
text_block_list.orig_text:
だろ～？
そうすると、
本気で頑張ろうって力が溢れてきてさ。
悪徳商人をやっている時には、
なかった感覚だよ～

text_block_list.name: Nea
text_block_list.text: I see. So you're taking it seriously... Hmm?
text_block_list.orig_text:
なるほど、
本気ね～……
ン？

text_block_list.name: Nea
text_block_list.text:
Alright~ outdoor playtime is over! It got
pretty fun when I got serious about it.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ほーい、
外遊び
しゅーりょ～
ガチると、
それなりにおもろかったわー

text_block_list.name: Nea
text_block_list.text:
Ah, could it be... That I never got serious
enough?
text_block_list.orig_text:
あっ、
もしかして……
『本気』が足りなかったっぽー？

text_block_list.name: Nea
text_block_list.text:
Even with that tag game... I was able to have
fun after taking it seriously.
text_block_list.orig_text:
鬼ごっこも、
ガチるとおもろかったし？
いつもより、
頑張れたんだよねー

text_block_list.name: Nea
text_block_list.text:
In other words, that "true power" thing... is
basically about going all out, right?
text_block_list.orig_text:
つまりー
ホンテって、
結局
本気出せって話なんじゃね～？

text_block_list.name: Nea
text_block_list.text:
I know, right... Man... when was the last
time I actually went all out...?
text_block_list.orig_text:
だよねー
つか
マジに全力出したの、
いつが最後だろ……？

text_block_list.name: Former Merchant
text_block_list.text:
Ummm... What are you two talking about?
Anyway, here's your pay for today's work.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ええっと……
さっきから
何の話をしているんだい？
とにかく、
これが
今日のバイト代だよ。

text_block_list.name: Nea
text_block_list.text:
Ah, sorry. Just a little chit-chatter. I've
learned a lot today. Pops, thank youuu~
text_block_list.orig_text:
あー　
ごめ。
こっちのハナシ。
今日は色々ベンキョーになったわー　
オッサンせんきゅ～

text_block_list.name: Former Merchant
text_block_list.text:
Eh? Ah, yeah. I should be the one thanking
you. I'm glad I was able to help you two~
text_block_list.orig_text:
え、
ああ。
こちらこそ、
ありがとう。
お嬢ちゃんたちの力になれたなら、
よかったよ～

text_block_list.name: Nea
text_block_list.text:
Nfufu♪ Me and Knight-kyun both are rooting
for you, y'know~ Good luck with your
rehabilitation, Pops!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ンフ・
アタシも騎士きゅんも応援してっから。
オッサンも更生ガンバってねー

text_block_list.name: Nea
text_block_list.text:
Well then, let's go, Knight-kyun~ I've gotta
fight Kariza-kyun seriously this time~
text_block_list.orig_text:
んじゃ、
行こっか
騎士きゅん～
──カリザきゅんを、
ガチんなきゃだわ～

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text:
Through this cleaning job with {0},
Nea arrived at a way to bring out her true
power. Humming to herself, she headed for the
plains where Kariza awaited.
text_block_list.orig_text:
{0}の清掃アルバイトを通じて、
真の力を発揮する方法に辿り着いたネア。
鼻歌交じりに、
カリザが待つ平原へ向かうのだった。
